messages.subject: New implementation of the z-model
parts:
is now added to testing version of today. This addition resolves some of
the issues in previous posts, where the A-matrix feature had to be
used.

It is currently marked as experimental, just in case someone has
comments on it.

There is a exmaple in inla.doc("z") which writes the same model in two
different ways: using the new z-model and using the A-matrix feature.
